content:
If you missed yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event but don't want to watch the entire over-an-hour-long video, Apple's YouTube channel has you covered. Check out the event recap below.

Apple shares event highlights

In addition to the iPhone Duo and Apple's first foldable iPhone, Apple also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, along with the Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

The event ran for nearly 1 hour and 20 minutes, following Apple's signature style with executives taking turns speaking to the camera, interspersed with plenty of product demonstrations and promotional videos.

If you really don't have time to watch the whole thing, Apple also released a shorter highlights reel, with narration skipping back and forth to walk you through the key points of each announcement.

Apple has also separately uploaded the full announcement video for each product, all of which can be watched below.
